text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Marine Parade Drive, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing parking prohibitions on the west/south side of Marine Parade Drive be changed to a stopping prohibition. The proposed amendment will deter parking at this location and will improve transit operations and vehicle movements by maintaining a clear passage for Toronto Transit Commission vehicles.

City Council on May 11 and 12, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the west/south side of Marine Parade Drive, between Lake Shore Boulevard West (west intersection) and a point 278 metres east. 2. City Council prohibit stopping at all times, on the west/south side of Marine Parade Drive, between Lake Shore Boulevard West (west intersection) and a point 278 metres east.
